about: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide at about −78.5 °C. It does not melt into liquid; it sublimates directly into CO₂ gas, so it keeps food and pharma products cold without leaving water behind. Typical uses are cold-chain shipping, food transport, event fog effects and cleaning.

Never touch it with bare hands and never store it in an airtight container or an unventilated space, including a closed car. Order close to when you need it, because dry ice sublimates steadily even in insulated boxes.
